children: KLX Energy Services announced its $125 million backstopped rights offering is nearing expiration on Sept 23, 2026.
Rights offering size $125 million; expiration at 5:00 pm NY time on September 23, 2026.
Each subscription right allows purchase of 3.885 shares at $1.49 per share.
Rights trade on Nasdaq under symbol KLXER until market close on the expiration date.
Exercise cap: holders cannot exceed 9.995% beneficial ownership on a pro forma basis.
Company may extend, amend or terminate the offering; brokers may impose earlier exercise deadlines.
